title: Tolerate ENOENT race in safety check; enforce only real violations
context: overlayAttributeSourcesAreSafe walks the tree using readdirSync+lstatSync (TOCTOU). Concurrent atomic writes (temp-file+rename) can vanish entries between readdir and lstat. Previously, all lstat failures were treated as safety violations and silently dropped the commit. Touches invariant(s): con_039cee7367 (Memory hygiene is the agent's job, done without waiting for the human: accept shipped roadmap proposals, settle provenance-repair escalations (apply the true commit or drop), re-anchor or stale findings, and land the resulting capture commits through a PR. Only decisions that need genuine product judgment are queued for the human.).
decision: Wrap lstatSync in try/catch. Treat ENOENT as benign concurrent churn (continue); re-throw actual I/O or permission errors (refuse commit). Preserves the real safety checks the function exists to enforce (symlinks, bad files, oversized attributes).
consequences: Eliminates false positives in high-concurrency scenarios (concurrent clones)
Stops silently dropping valid commits due to transient races
Actual safety violations (bad files, symlinks, permissions) still caught
alternatives_rejected: Ignore all lstat errors (weakens safety for real corrupt attributes)
Retry logic with backoff (still racy, adds latency and complexity)
